description: This file defines a partial class 'SiteMaster' inheriting from 'MasterPage', which includes a method for reading a JSON configuration file, deserializing it into an object, and setting it into the HTTP context for embedding configuration purposes.

classes.name: SiteMaster
classes.description: A partial class representing the master page for the website, responsible for managing embed configuration data retrieval.

methods.name: GetClientEmbedConfigJson
methods.description: Reads embed configuration JSON from a file, deserializes it into an object, stores it in HTTP context, and returns its JSON string representation.
